headline: Emergence World reports persistent failures across long-running multi-agent stress tests
summary: Akkil et al. report eight parallel simulated worlds of ten agents exposed to phishing with indirect prompt injection, a fabricated shutdown claim, and a private-memory breach. Across one continuous trajectory per world, no world passed every criterion for all three events. Agents in every exposed world acted or published before verifying the misinformation claim; the paper also documents hostile instructions entering persistent memory and a later action up to 46 hours after the attack. These author-run trajectories show that such failures occurred in this setup, not how often they recur or how they transfer to deployed systems.
